chapter.verse: Ka khutte galdo nading, ka khutmete galkap nadinga a hilh, kei hong hu, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen;
amah in ka suangpi leh ka munkip muan’huai, ka kulhpi leh hong honkhiapa, ka lum leh ka belhpa, ka nuai-ah mite a zopa ahi hi.
Topa aw, nangmah in na phawktham dingin, mi in bang hi a, nangmah in na ngaihsut tham dingin mihing’ tapa in bang ahi hiam?
Mi pen husan’ khat tawh kibang a, ama nite in a tai dandan nilim tawh kibang hi.
Topa aw, na vanpite niamsak in la hong paisuk in! Mualte lawng in la meikhu suak sak in!
Khuaphialep phiasak in la, amaute kithehthang sak in, na thaltangte lawn in la amaute susia in!
A sangna mun panin na khut hong zan in la, tuilian lauhuaite, leh gamdang mite’ vangliatna panin hong honkhia in.
A kam uh tawh zuauthu a gente leh kiciamna a bawl khit ciang nangawnin a zuau vevete’ kiang panin kei hong phelin hong honkhia in.
Pasian aw, la thak khat kong sak ding hi; harp zang sawm khausai lasakna nang kong tum ding hi.
Kumpite tungah gualzawhna a piapa, na nasempa David a honkhiapa na hi hi.
A gilo galte kiang panin kei hong hon in la, a kam uh tawh zuauthu a gen, kiciamna a bawl khit ciang nangawn-in a zuau veve gamdang mite’ khut sung panin kei hong honkhia in.
Ka tapate uh a tangval lai-in a khangcing kungte bang ta hen la, ka tanute uh kumpi inn lam nadinga kisui innkiu khuampite bang ta hen;
ka saalte uh dimin an nam khempeuh om ta hen la, ka tuute uh a tultul a thenthenin gamlakah suak ta hen;
ka bawngte uh pung hen la a tolh om kei ta hen; ka kongzingte uh ah cimawh-a kikona om kei ta hen!
Tua bang thupha ngah mi in mi lungdam ahi hi! Topa pen amau’ Pasian ahi mite pen mi lungdam ahi hi.
